Sam: Quick design check — I pushed a new composer frame with a severity slider + inline rule-context preview. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/severity-composer (frame v3). Main asks: microcopy for the slider tooltip, keyboard behavior, and ARIA for the preview region. :eyes: Priya: Nice. Microcopy nit — change the tooltip from 'Severity level' to 'Incident severity (higher = louder notifications)'. Also propose default = P2 so teams have a middle ground. Jordan: Accessibility: when the slider updates the preview we need an aria-live announcement. Also make sure focus doesn't jump — the preview is informative, not interactive. Keyboard support: left/right arrows = step 1, PageUp/PageDown = step 2-3. Liam: UX note — preview header reads 'Preview' now; suggest 'How this alert will behave when triggered' to set context. When suppression is active we should dim the channel list and show inline 'Suppressed until ' so it's obvious why channels are muted. Sam: Good catches. Proposed aria snippet I mocked up: ```
Preview: alerts will trigger at P2
``` Is role="status" OK or should we use assertive for P1? Priya: role="status" is right for non-interruptive updates. Maybe switch to aria-live="assertive" only when severity === P1, but be careful — assertive can be disruptive. Happy to iterate with PM on that. Jordan: Prefer handling it in JS: keep aria-atomic and only update the inner text when there is a real change; add a skip link above preview so keyboard users can jump directly: 'Skip to preview' -> focus preview container. Also add aria-describedby on the slider that points to the preview-summary. Liam: Copy variant suggestion for the slider tooltip: [P1] 'Immediate incident — page on-call', [P2] 'High — notify primary channels', [P3] 'Medium — standard alerts', [P4] 'Low — info only'. That makes actionability clearer. Sam: Will add those copy variants and wire the skip link. For the suppression edge case: if a rule is suppressed by schedule, the preview should show a small inline pill: 'Suppressed until 2024-10-01 09:00 UTC' and deactivate channel toggles. Should we also add a tooltip on the pill explaining why? Priya: Yes, tooltip + link to the schedule editor. Keep the pill keyboard-focusable. design-bot: Uploaded image: composer_severity_v3.png :frame_with_picture: Sam: Thanks — I'll iterate and push an updated figma frame with keyboard notes + ARIA snippets. I'll also add a tiny test plan for QA: keyboard nav, screenreader reads, suppression pill focus. Thanks everyone :grinning: Liam: :thumbsup:
